results.description: This add-on allows you to convert the first post of an existing forum thread into a resource manager resource. The newly created resource will be posted under the original thread starter and will retain the original thread date.
results.title: Unmaintained - Convert Threads to Resources | XenForo community

results.description: I searched this forum, but can not find anything. Is there a way to show a list of related threads at the bottom of an individual thread?
results.title: Is there a way to show Related Threads below... | XenForo community

results.description: Moderators can reply to locked threads already (if they have permission to unlock the thread). Otherwise you can put the thread in its own forum. You can set permissions for a forum, not an individual thread.
